chunks: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from al-Hasan ibn Rashid, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) or to Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him): 'A man deliberately fasts one month during the short days and counts it as his fast for the year.' He said, 'There is no harm in that.'
ai.seo_question: Can a Muslim intentionally fast one month during the shorter days to fulfill their annual obligatory fast?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the fiqh of *ta'abbud* (voluntary intention) regarding the validity of fasting a specific month during shorter days to fulfill the annual obligatory fast. It establishes that if one intentionally fasts a month with the specific intention of discharging the annual duty, the act is valid and there is no objection, highlighting the flexibility in Shia jurisprudence regarding the timing of intention (*niyyah*) relative to the actual fasting period.
